messages:
mara: Heads up — I sketched a migration to normalize route/tenant IDs out of the console telemetry blobs so queries for per-route quotas/dashboards stop doing jsonb_extract every time. Wanted to get 👍/concerns before I open an RFC.

samir: SGTM in principle. Can you paste the current and target shapes? curious about index needs.

mara: Current: telemetry.event -> { envelope: { route: { id, name }, tenant: { id }, payload: ... } } Target: top-level columns route_id, tenant_id, route_meta JSONB (small), and keep envelope for compat. Means backfill route_id for historical events.

linh: Why keep envelope? if we keep whole blob we don't reduce storage.

mara: We keep envelope for compatibility w/ older consumers. Plan is to mark envelope deprecated in queries and remove after N months + verification. Immediate win is indexed route_id so dashboard queries stop full jsonb scans.

kevin: Backfill strategy? big table, can't lock for hours.

mara: Dual-write + async backfill. Steps: 1) dual-write new column on ingest (feature-flagged) 2) deploy query rewrite in console to prefer route_id when present 3) async backfill in batches with safe concurrency 4) drop json extraction in hot paths 5) remove envelope after 90 days if no regressions.

ashley: For step 1 we need schema migration that adds nullable column and index concurrently. Also need to update the ingest contract.

mara: Agreed. Draft SQL:
```sql
ALTER TABLE telemetry_events ADD COLUMN route_id TEXT;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_route_id ON telemetry_events(route_id);
```
We'll set route_id from message on write path and fall back to json_extract for reads while we ramp.

samir: Async backfill command snippet? want to ensure we rate limit.

mara: Backfill sketch:
```bash
psql -c "UPDATE telemetry_events SET route_id = (envelope->'route'->>'id') WHERE route_id IS NULL AND id BETWEEN $START AND $END"
```
We'll run with batching of 10k rows and a sleep, and monitor replication lag.

linh: How will console rollouts work? feature flag per org? per-cluster?

mara: Feature flag per route/tenant is best — we can enable dual-write for a small % of traffic first, then bump. Console query rewrite behind a flag for UI teams so we can toggle if dashboards regress.

kevin: Concern: analytics pipelines that consume envelope will see duplicates if we dual-write differently. We need idempotency key on ingest and include a source_version header so downstream can dedupe.

ashley: Also need to update retention/backfill budgets — backfill will scan a lot and increase cost. Ops should allocate credits and we should throttle by max RPS.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: add column migration prepared in staging, running schema DDL in canary next window.

mara: Testing checklist: unit for ingest mapping, integration test for query rewrite preferring route_id, staging end-to-end with dashboards comparing numbers before/after, sampling of high-cardinality tenants.

samir: Indexing: consider partial index for route_id IS NOT NULL to speed queries and reduce index bloat. Also multi-column index with (route_id, event_kind) for our common filters.

mara: Good call. We'll add:
```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_telemetry_routeid_notnull ON telemetry_events(route_id) WHERE route_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_telemetry_route_eventkind ON telemetry_events(route_id, event_kind);
```

linh: Rollback plan? If backfill or dual-write causes issues.

mara: Rollback steps: 1) flip ingest feature flag off (stop populating route_id) 2) revert query rewrite to json_extract 3) drop new indexes if necessary (careful). Don't drop column until we're certain.

kevin: Monitoring: add GAUGE for percent_rows_with_route_id, dashboard for query latencies on dashboard endpoints, and an alert if more than 1% of dashboard queries error or tail latency > 2x baseline.

ashley: We should also add an eval job that runs our canonical dashboard SQL against both paths and diffs results nightly for first 2 weeks.

mara: Yep — nightly diff + per-tenant regression alert. I'll draft RFC with the phased timeline and ownership (ingest: @samir, backfill: @kevin, queries/UI: @linh, rollout ops: @ashley). Posting RFC shortly.

linh: One more thing — caching layer might mask missing route_id. We should invalidate caches when enabling rewrite.

mara: noted. Thanks all. I'll post RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
